entry.name: jit.turtle
entry.description: The jit.turtle object emulates simple LOGO-style graphics. It interprets single char values in its inlet as ASCII letters that describe turtle graphics commands. A valid ASCII input will generate appropriate drawing commands for use with either the Max lcd object or the jit.lcd object.
